def compute_stats(label, data_dict):
    vals = list(data_dict.values())
    n = len(vals)
    total = sum(vals)
    avg = total / n
    mx = max(vals)
    mn = min(vals)
    rng = mx - mn
    pct = (rng / avg) * 100
    print(f"\n{label}:")
    print(f"  Months: {list(data_dict.keys())}")
    print(f"  Values: {vals}")
    print(f"  Sum: {total}, n={n}")
    print(f"  Average: {avg}")
    print(f"  Max: {mx}, Min: {mn}")
    print(f"  Range: {rng}")
    print(f"  Range % of avg: {pct}")
    return pct
